note: next integrates Drupal with Next.js. The Next.js app, JSON:API/GraphQL traffic and real preview/revalidation are external, so all medium/hard eval state is grounded in LOCAL Drupal config: the next_site config entity (next.next_site.<id>: base_url, preview_url, preview_secret, revalidate_url, revalidate_secret) and the next_entity_type_config config entity (id = <entity_type>.<bundle>: site_resolver, configuration, draft_enabled, revalidator, revalidator_configuration), plus the global next.settings (site_previewer=iframe, preview_url_generator=simple_oauth, debug). Introspection reads a preset next_site / next_entity_type_config; execution creates a next_site and maps a content type via next_entity_type_config, verified against the live config entities. Namespaced ids: nextzz_* (sites) and node.article / node.page (entity type configs).

evals.prompt: In the Drupal 'next' (Next.js) module, what are the two config entity types used to configure the integration, and what does the next_site entity store?
evals.expected_output: next_site (one per Next.js front end: id, label, base_url, preview_url, preview_secret, revalidate_url, revalidate_secret) and next_entity_type_config (maps an entity_type.bundle to sites via a site_resolver, plus draft_enabled and a revalidator). The next_entity_type_config id is '<entity_type>.<bundle>', e.g. node.article.

evals.prompt: The next module is built around pluggable behaviors. What plugin types does it define, and give a built-in plugin for one of them.
evals.expected_output: Four plugin types: site_resolver (site_selector, entity_reference_field), site_previewer (iframe), preview_url_generator (simple_oauth; jwt in next_jwt), and revalidator (path, cache_tag).

evals.prompt: Out of the box, which site previewer and which preview URL generator does the next module use (the defaults in next.settings)?
evals.expected_output: Default site_previewer is 'iframe' and default preview_url_generator is 'simple_oauth' (with secret_expiration 30 minutes); debug is false. These live in the next.settings config object.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has a Next.js site (next_site config entity) with id nextzz_known configured. Inspect the live configuration and report its base URL.
evals.expected_output: The next_site nextzz_known has base_url = https://known.example.com (config next.next_site.nextzz_known). Read via drush cget next.next_site.nextzz_known or the next_site entity's getBaseUrl().

evals.prompt: On this site the Article content type is already configured for Next.js (a next_entity_type_config with id node.article). Inspect the live configuration and state which site_resolver plugin and which revalidator plugin are configured for it.
evals.expected_output: The next_entity_type_config node.article uses site_resolver = site_selector (configuration.sites includes nextzz_m2) and revalidator = path. Read via drush cget next.next_entity_type_config.node.article.

evals.prompt: Register a new Next.js front end with the next module by creating a next_site config entity with id nextzz_task, label 'Task Site', base_url https://task.example.com, preview_url https://task.example.com/api/preview, preview_secret 'tasksecret', revalidate_url https://task.example.com/api/revalidate and revalidate_secret 'tasksecret'. Save it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A next_site config entity nextzz_task exists (config next.next_site.nextzz_task) with base_url = https://task.example.com and preview_url/revalidate_url set. Create via \Drupal\next\Entity\NextSite::create([...])->save().

evals.prompt: I have a Next.js site already registered in Drupal called nextzz_map. Make the Basic page content type (machine name 'page') use that Next.js site and rebuild its pages when a page changes. Concretely, configure the next module so the 'page' content type resolves to the nextzz_map site (manual site selection) and uses path-based on-demand revalidation. Save it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A next_entity_type_config with id node.page exists with site_resolver = site_selector, configuration.sites containing 'nextzz_map', and revalidator = path. Create via \Drupal\next\Entity\NextEntityTypeConfig::create(['id' => 'node.page', 'site_resolver' => 'site_selector', 'configuration' => ['sites' => ['nextzz_map']], 'revalidator' => 'path', 'revalidator_configuration' => ['revalidate_page' => 1]])->save().
